CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION AGENDA
  TUESDAY, MAY 26, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Kevin McGuan, Chair  Jacqueline Padilla-Perez, Commissioner
Mark Grisafe, Vice Chair  Marco Pizzo, Commissioner
Amy Bodek, Commissioner  Jocelynn Pryor, Commissioner
Tasha Hunter, Commissioner

  Cultural Heritage Commission In-Person Meeting

  Members of the public have the option to email comments
  to cultural.heritage@longbeach.gov

  Comments may also be provided in the Zoom meeting using the raise hand function or by
  pressing *9 on your phone

  Please dial: (213) 338-8477 / Meeting ID: 982 3985 6018
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/98239856018

  Please note the Zoom meeting may encounter technical disruptions, but in-person access
  and public comment will continue to be available in accordance with the Brown Act

  Please view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  via: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55179  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55180  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Cultural Heritage Commission
  meeting of Tuesday, March 31, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55193  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-26-043, finding the
  proposed project exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15303, Class 3 (New Construction or

  Conversion of Small Structures); and

  Approve a Certificate of Appropriateness (COAC2511-01) at 755 Orange Avenue,
  to construct a detached two-story structure consisting of 936 square-foot garage
  area and 259 square-foot storage/laundry area on the first floor. Two 603-square-
  foot Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) over the proposed new garage structure
  were approved administratively as required by state law. The request also includes
  the demolition of an existing 309-square-foot two-car garage and demolition of an
  existing 260-square-foot storage area on the rear of the primary duplex structure.
  The property is located within the Hellman Street Craftsman Historic District, and
  the existing primary structure is a Contributing Structure in the R-2-N Zoning
  District. (District 1)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Cultural Heritage Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:04 PM, Chair McGuan called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Bodek, Hunter, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Pryor, Grisafe, McGuan

Also present: Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Marissa Moshier, Environmental and
Cultural Resources Officer, Felice Delgado, Clerk Typist, Erin Weesner-McKinley, Principal Deputy
City Attorney, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist.

Commissioner Padilla-Perez led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

  A motion was made by Commissioner Padilla-Perez, seconded by
  Commissioner Pryor, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  7  Bodek, Hunter, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Pryor, Grisafe, McGuan
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Marissa Moshier, Environmental and Cultural Resources Officer, Community
  Development, spoke; and provided the Director’s Report.

  Chair McGuan spoke.

  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

3.  26-55193  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-26-043, finding the
  proposed project exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15303, Class 3 (New Construction or
  Conversion of Small Structures); and

  Approve a Certificate of Appropriateness (COAC2511-01) at 755 Orange Avenue,
  to construct a detached two-story structure consisting of 936 square-foot garage
  area and 259 square-foot storage/laundry area on the first floor. Two 603-square-
  foot Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) over the proposed new garage structure
  were approved administratively as required by state law. The request also includes
  the demolition of an existing 309-square-foot two-car garage and demolition of an
  existing 260-square-foot storage area on the rear of the primary duplex structure.
  The property is located within the Hellman Street Craftsman Historic District, and
  the existing primary structure is a Contributing Structure in the R-2-N Zoning
  District. (District 1)

  A motion was made by Commissioner Pizzo, seconded by Commissioner
  Hunter, to approve recommendation. No vote was taken on the motion.

  A substitute motion was made by Commissioner Bodek, seconded by
  Commissioner Pizzo, to [1] accept Categorical Exemption CE-26-043; [2]
  approve a Certificate of Appropriateness (COAC2511-01) at 755 Orange
  Avenue, to demolish an existing 260-square-foot storage area on the rear of
  the primary duplex structure; and [3] deny a Certificate of Appropriateness
  (COAC2511-01) at 755 Orange Avenue, to construct a detached two-story
  structure consisting of 936 square-foot garage area and 259 square-foot
  storage/laundry area on the first floor and deny the demolition of an existing
